purpose: Reference-led geometry study for four of the ten sampled plants. Institutional botanical descriptions guide anatomy; source imagery is not included in exported texture maps.

plants.name: Cattleya orchid
plants.geometry: Elongated club-shaped pseudobulbs, one firm oblong leaf per growth, exposed velamen roots, terminal flower sheaths, three slim sepals, two broad waved petals, and a projecting rolled labellum with an expanded frilled lip.
plants.stages: A single rooted young growth becomes a three-growth clump before the mature five-growth plant develops two terminal flower sprays. Closed buds share the open flowers' exact attachment positions.

plants.name: Slipper orchid
plants.geometry: Two shallow fans of arching strap leaves without pseudobulbs, each bearing one flower on a bare stalk. A tall white-edged dorsal sepal, undulating lateral petals, rear synsepal, staminodal shield, and open inflated pouch create a bilateral flower.
plants.stages: Three-leaf plantlet, five-leaf juvenile fan, then two six-leaf mature fans. The flower pouch is open at its rim and closed below.

plants.name: Cornflower
plants.geometry: Curved stems with axillary branches, broader lightly divided basal leaves, narrow alternate upper leaves, and nine individual composite flower heads. Each head contains enlarged fringed tubular outer florets, a compact inner disc, and a layered green involucre.
plants.stages: Low leafy rosette, two developing leafy stems, then branched mature stems with bracted heads and individual attached buds.

plants.name: Snowdrop
plants.geometry: Five small shoots, each with paired basal blades and one leafless flowering scape, a spathe and recurved pedicel. Nodding flowers have three long bowed white outer tepals and three shorter notched inner tepals with green apical markings.
plants.stages: Paired emerging leaves, a three-shoot juvenile clump, then the five flowering shoots. Pendent white buds attach to the same hanging neck as each flower.
